name: m4
description: GNU M4 macro processor, copying input to output while expanding macros; used as a core dependency of the GNU Autotools build system (Autoconf, Automake, Libtool).
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
